# Experiments

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_docs.py from reports/experiments/*.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

All experiments use the MVTec AD cable split (224 normal training images, 150 test images) and the unchanged method: ResNet18 `layer3` patches, Euclidean 1-NN to a normal-only bank, 95th-percentile image score, threshold at the 99th percentile of normal validation scores. Protocol: pre-registered exploratory comparison; test labels are used only for final reporting.

**Latency in this file** measures nearest-neighbour scoring only (features are precomputed), so it is not comparable with the end-to-end latency in the README.

## 1. Reference-bank size

Changed variable: reference patch cap. Banks are nested prefixes of one permutation (sampling seed 2027); the threshold is recalibrated for each size.

| Patch cap | Threshold | Precision | Recall | F1 | ROC-AUC | Confusion matrix | Scoring latency (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5,000 | 0.6709 | 1.0000 | 0.7609 | 0.8642 | 0.9895 | `[[58, 0], [22, 70]]` | 9.7 |
| 10,000 | 0.6377 | 1.0000 | 0.8804 | 0.9364 | 0.9895 | `[[58, 0], [11, 81]]` | 14.5 |
| 20,000 | 0.6225 | 1.0000 | 0.8587 | 0.9240 | 0.9888 | `[[58, 0], [13, 79]]` | 27.1 |
| 30,000 | 0.6033 | 0.9880 | 0.8913 | 0.9371 | 0.9923 | `[[57, 1], [10, 82]]` | 37.4 |

Note: the 30,000 row is **not** the recorded baseline. The baseline samples its 30,000 patches with the seed-42 generator that also made the split; this experiment uses a separate nested permutation, so the thresholds and metrics differ.

## 2. Image-score aggregation

Changed variable: image score aggregation percentile. Uses the recorded baseline bank (artifact schema v2); the threshold is recalibrated per percentile on the normal validation split.

| Patch-score percentile | Threshold | Precision | Recall | F1 | ROC-AUC | Confusion matrix |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 90 | 0.5708 | 0.9870 | 0.8261 | 0.8994 | 0.9820 | `[[57, 1], [16, 76]]` |
| 95 | 0.6180 | 1.0000 | 0.8261 | 0.9048 | 0.9936 | `[[58, 0], [16, 76]]` |
| 99 | 0.6947 | 1.0000 | 0.7935 | 0.8848 | 0.9978 | `[[58, 0], [19, 73]]` |

The 95th-percentile row reproduces the recorded baseline exactly.

### Per-category outcome (original images)

Defect categories contain only anomalous images, so only the detection rate is meaningful there; the good category reports normal acceptance.

| Category | Images | Detected / false positives | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| bent_wire | 13 | 13 detected | 1.0000 detection |
| cable_swap | 12 | 7 detected | 0.5833 detection |
| combined | 11 | 11 detected | 1.0000 detection |
| cut_inner_insulation | 14 | 14 detected | 1.0000 detection |
| cut_outer_insulation | 10 | 7 detected | 0.7000 detection |
| good | 58 | 0 false positives | 1.0000 acceptance |
| missing_cable | 12 | 12 detected | 1.0000 detection |
| missing_wire | 10 | 5 detected | 0.5000 detection |
| poke_insulation | 10 | 7 detected | 0.7000 detection |

16 false negatives: cable_swap 5, missing_wire 5, cut_outer_insulation 3, poke_insulation 3. Their scores fall 0.0003–0.0471 below the threshold.

Limitation: Synthetic conditions are not a substitute for real production camera and lighting variation.
